title: Coverage Recheck After a Return Home — Home Oxygen Therapy Payment Periods
content:
# Coverage Recheck After a Return Home — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** A new Home Oxygen Therapy payment period after a break begins on the day home instead of the day of confirmation only when the coverage's last eligibility check is dated on or after the day home and no more than the window below after it. The coverage is the one named on the oxygen record; its class and its last eligibility check date are read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the new payment period begins on the day the patient confirms continuing.

| Coverage class | Last eligibility check: on or after the day home and no more than |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G | 90 days after it |
| Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO | 30 days after it |
| any other coverage class | 0 days after it (the check falls on the day home itself) |

## Both sides (hypothetical, day home 1 April)

| Coverage class | Last eligibility check | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 30 June (90 days after) | met |
| Original Medicare Part B | 1 July (91 days after) | fails |
| Commercial HMO | 1 May (30 days after) | met |
| Commercial HMO | 2 May (31 days after) | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 1 April | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 2 April | fails |
| any class | 31 March (before the day home) | fails |
